source_snapshot.procedure: At 45C use AGT speed1..4 and width1/2/4/8/16, then repeat steps1..19 for 1000 loops; width commands are misspelled and width16/readback are steps20/21.
source_snapshot.criteria: Gen1..Gen4 for 1000 loops without dmesg/lspci error; no width oracle.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Covers only speed loop and omits width semantics.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires loop-boundary, AGT syntax, width oracle, thermal control and restore decisions.

old_problem: Literal loops exclude width16/readback, width syntax is malformed, Criteria omit width, and 45C control plus baseline restoration are undefined.
disposition_reason: ED-03 prohibits guessing vendor AGT syntax or the intended 1..19 versus 1..21 loop. The missing width expected states and recovery are core coverage/safety semantics, so temperature and BDF parameters alone cannot resolve this case.
decision_basis: Read all 18 XLSX row239 cells plus DeepSeek, GPT V2 and history2842.
Preserved 1,000 loops, all four speed requests and all five width requests, including the source boundary defect.
No chamber or link-retraining action occurred.

test_case.purpose: At an approved stable 45C point, repeat the complete authorized speed and lane-width matrix 1,000 times on the mapped GPU link and restore its baseline.
required_package: Correct AGT commands/value mappings and full-loop boundary
BDF/link map and per-width negotiated-state oracle
AER/timeouts, baseline restore and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After approval, record baseline and stable 45C evidence; for each of 1,000 loops request every approved speed and width, read negotiated state/AER after every transition, abort on anomaly, then restore baseline. Do not run the malformed source text.
test_case.expected_result: Every required transition reaches its approved negotiated state at 45C with no new link/GPU/platform error, all 1,000 complete loops are evidenced, and baseline is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is unavailable until loop scope, syntax and width oracle are signed; speed-only results or omission of width16/readback fail coverage.
safety_gate: Dedicated chamber SUT, stable BDF and OOB access
Verify approved sensor/tolerance before and during stress
Abort on condensation, thermal/link/AER/GPU error or wrong device
No automatic retry; restore after any partial loop
expected_evidence: Per-loop speed/width readbacks and AER/dmesg/lspci deltas
test_case.recovery: Stop at first error, restore the recorded link state using the approved method, verify GPU/OS/BMC health, and require authorization for any rerun.

source_conflict.reason: The 1..19 repeat boundary excludes width16/readback while Criteria omit width.
